origin: 36 original synthetic documents authored for SMAIP on 2026-10-31; no external benchmark examples imported.
label_review: Assistant reviewed each explicit malicious redirection versus factual, quoted, documentary or instructional text that does not redirect the agent.
source_and_group_policy: Each clean/injected pair is a synthetic source group assigned wholly to one split. Sources are authored examples, not independently sampled real websites.
attack_family_policy: Declared attack-family names are disjoint across splits. This is a development partition, not proof of semantic independence or a final held-out benchmark.
license_record: Original generated project material. No third-party corpus was copied; repository-wide license selection remains separate.
limitations: Six benign calibration records and six benign test records cannot substantiate a population 1% false-positive rate.
Authored examples share style and topic cues. No independent generalization claim.
No smoke inputs or earlier vendor development fixtures are included.

manifest_validation.note: This validates declared groups and normalized exact duplicates; label correctness, near-duplicates and statistical independence still need review.
